policy: Every root tests/*.js, *.cjs or *.py file must be either wired into Frontend CI or explicitly classified as legacy with a rewrite/retire reason.

legacyRewrite.catalog-browser.js: V7 browser-authoritative acceptance flow; rewrite useful scenarios around API fixtures and server-authoritative state before enabling.
legacyRewrite.css-architecture.js: Storefront CSS checks are useful, but the current dashboard still loads Boxicons through a legacy @import; migrate that dependency to explicit HTML loading before enabling this contract.
legacyRewrite.dashboard-v9-unit.js: Mixes useful birthday date logic with browser-local hard-delete/domain mutation; split pure rules from server-authoritative operations.
legacyRewrite.platform-unit.js: Mixes current source contracts with legacy local register/checkout/reward state; business flows belong to backend/API tests.
legacyRewrite.rep-unit.js: Routing assertions are useful, but representative auth/orders/returns are browser-local; extract routing contracts and keep business state server-authoritative.
legacyRewrite.returns-accounting-unit.js: Exercises browser-side return accounting/rollback including proportional order discounts; authoritative return and reward accounting must be tested on the backend.
legacyRewrite.static_checks.py: Large brittle V7/V8 static bundle with duplicate and historical assertions; migrate still-useful generic HTML checks into focused current contracts.
legacyRewrite.tracking-unit.js: Contains valuable routing/map source contracts but resolves orders/returns from localStorage; split static route contracts from server-backed tracking tests.
legacyRewrite.v8-features-browser.js: V8 acceptance suite mutates dashboard arrays/localStorage directly; rewrite selected flows with API fixtures.
legacyRewrite.v9-requested-features.js: Historical source-marker suite includes pre-current discount-priority assumptions; replace with focused current contracts and backend reward tests.

legacyRetire.catalog-pricing-unit.js: Asserts Site discount overrides Model/item discount, which conflicts with current per-item priority: item discount, campaign, birthday, Dart Card.
